name: figcraft
description: Design in FigCraft from natural language: create and edit UI layouts, frames, components, styles, variables and whiteboard boards, render screenshots, and export PNG/SVG/PDF — powered by the local FigCraft MCP server.
author: storytold
skillInstructions: Use the figcraft MCP server tools for any design task: create_node / set_properties to build layers, run_command + batch for commands, inspect_document / get_node / screenshot to verify, export to write PNG/SVG/PDF files. See the bundled skill for conventions.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-driven interface design and prototyping with FigCraft
interface.longDescription: Design in FigCraft from natural language: create and edit UI layouts, frames, components, styles, variables and whiteboard boards, render screenshots, and export PNG/SVG/PDF — powered by the local FigCraft MCP server.
tryPrompts: Create a mobile login screen mockup and export it as PNG
Build a kanban board with stickies for my sprint retro
Make a landing page from the template and save it as a .figcraft file
